# Robin Francis - Full AI Context

Canonical website: https://www.robinfrancis.in/

## Entity Summary

Robin Francis is an AI innovator, community leader, and software engineer from Kerala, India. His portfolio focuses on accessible technology, community engineering, AI/ML systems, and full-stack product development.

## Primary Claims

- IEEE R10 Outstanding Volunteer Award 2024 recipient.
- IBM Watsonx GenAI Challenge 1st Runner-Up.
- 3x hackathon winner across GenAI, sustainability, and game development competitions.
- Founded and led TechX Infinia, an IEEE Computer Society flagship event with 450+ participants.
- Raised $2,650+ for community-impact projects.
- National bronze medalist in .22 rifle shooting.

## Education

- B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Sahrdaya College of Engineering & Technology, 2021-2025, CGPA 7.17.
- Higher Secondary, Computer Science, National Higher Secondary School, 2019-2021, secured 96%.
- Secondary School Certificate, Don Bosco High School, 2019, secured 100%.

## Focus Areas

- Artificial intelligence and machine learning.
- Generative AI and computer vision.
- React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase.
- Accessibility-centered technology and social-impact engineering.
- Community leadership, mentorship, and technical event strategy.

## Featured Projects

- SoulSync: AI companion for cognitive wellness using facial recognition, emotion tracking, and memory recall workflows for elders and caregivers.
- FoodLoop: AI platform for responsible food redistribution using machine learning surplus prediction to reduce food waste.
- TechX Infinia: Emerging technology flagship event founded and led by Robin Francis.
- IEEE R10 Career Fair: International virtual career fair with 31 global recruiters and 245 participants.
- STRIDE Website: Digital hub for assistive technology innovation in Kerala.
